От нашей земли — к вашему столу: From our land to your table
Уже больше десяти лет для гостей Ак-Тенг: For more than ten years, our trusted team of cooks has been feeding Ak-Tengir’s guests. Every morning we bake fresh bread and pastries, we cook national dishes over an open fire, and in summer and autumn we preserve the vegetables and fruit grown right here at Ak-Tengir.
Наш огород создан по принципам пермакуль: Our vegetable garden follows the principles of permaculture. It was laid out more than ten years ago by a specialist from Italy: the soil was built up in layers using natural felt and different types of earth. This keeps moisture in, preserves fertility and creates a natural environment for the plants.
Сегодня здесь растут свежие травы, бакла: Today we grow fresh herbs, aubergines, tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers and cabbage, and the orchard has apple, cherry and sweet cherry trees, and even a ginkgo biloba.
Большая часть того, что выращивает наша: Most of what our land grows ends up on our guests’ table. We make compotes, drinks and smoothies from our own apples and local seasonal fruit and serve them at breakfast, lunch and dinner.

— врач-психиатр и нарколог, доктор медиц: is a psychiatrist and addiction specialist, Doctor of Medical Sciences, professor, founder of the Dr Nazaraliev Medical Centre and of the World League “Mind Free of Drugs”.
С начала 1990-х его профессиональный пут: Since the early 1990s, his work has focused on the human psyche, addiction and our capacity for inner transformation. But his search never stayed within the walls of a clinic.
Профессор Назаралиев путешествовал по ми: Professor Nazaraliev travelled the world, learning from different countries and cultures. His path crossed five continents, from India and the Himalayas to Africa and South America. He studied medical approaches, spiritual traditions, and meditative and body practices of many peoples. Part of that journey became his book “Deliver and Forgive”.
Все эти годы он искал и своё место — про: All those years he was also looking for his own place: somewhere nature, silence and distance from the outside world could become part of a person’s inner work. That is how Ak-Tengir, the “Bright Space”, came to be on the south shore of Issyk-Kul.
Ак-Тенгир оставался закрытым пространств: Ak-Tengir remained a closed space. Guests and patients of Jenishbek Nazaraliev came here to recover, and it hosted psychological trainings and practices. Athletes, including Olympians, and business people from many countries came too. The Bright Space was open by personal invitation only.
Сегодня историю Ак-Тенгира продолжает се: Today the founder’s family carries Ak-Tengir’s story forward. For the first time, its doors are open wider: to guests from Kyrgyzstan and travellers from all over the world. We carefully keep what this place was chosen for: privacy, silence, closeness to nature and a chance to step out of everyday life for a while.
Мы приглашаем вас познакомиться с его ис: We invite you to discover its story and philosophy, and this hidden corner between the mountains and Issyk-Kul, created with love and meaning.

Ак-Тенгир — удобная точка для путешестви: Ak-Tengir is a convenient base for exploring the south shore of Issyk-Kul. Canyons, mountain gorges, waterfalls and nomadic traditions are all close by.
Красно-оранжевые скалы, причудливые форм: Red and orange rocks, strange shapes and panoramic views of Issyk-Kul. Especially beautiful at sunset.
Горное ущелье с еловыми лесами, рекой и: A mountain gorge with spruce forests, a river and several waterfalls. On the way you pass a monument to Yuri Gagarin. The waterfalls are about 15–20 km into the gorge from Barskoon.
Знакомство с традицией беркутчи — кыргыз: A chance to see berkutchi, the Kyrgyz tradition of hunting with golden eagles. Shows are usually arranged in advance.
Знаменитые красные скалы «Семь быков» и: The famous red rocks “Seven Bulls” and “Broken Heart”, and further on the Kok-Jaiyk mountain valley, walks and waterfalls.
Главный город восточного Иссык-Куля: ста: The main town of eastern Issyk-Kul: old wooden architecture, the Dungan Mosque, markets, cafés and Karakol’s famous cuisine.
Одна из главных горнолыжных баз Кыргызст: One of Kyrgyzstan’s main ski resorts, among Tian Shan spruces. In winter: skiing and snowboarding, high-altitude runs and panoramic views of Issyk-Kul.
